title: Online Detector
description:
The Online Detector is a block that emits a redstone signal when a player you specify is online. Simply right click the block to open up its gui and input the name of the player you want to detect. While the specified player is online the block will emit a redstone signal, otherwise it won't. It checks once per second and goes by the username.

The player name is case sensitive.

properties.label: Redstone
properties.value: Power 15 on all sides while the player is online
